result:
The deletion of `StopWatchTest.java` predates my work (it was already reflected in the git status at conversation start) and I didn't touch it — only added the new file.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/StopWatchAgentTest.java` with 71 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `StopWatch`'s public API: state transitions (start/stop/suspend/resume/reset) and their `IllegalStateException` error cases, split/unsplit behavior and the split list, timing accessors (`getNanoTime`, `getTime`, `getDuration`, split/start/stop instants), the `getStopTime()` null-instant edge case, `format*`/`toString`/`toSplitString`, the functional helpers (`get`, `getT`, `run`, `runT`) including checked-exception propagation, and the nested `Split` class. Verified with `mvn test -Dtest=StopWatchAgentTest` — all 71 tests pass.
